newsitem.title: USA: Pilgrim America sets rights expiration date.
newsitem.headline: Pilgrim America sets rights expiration date.

text.p: Pilgrim America Prime Rate Trust said on Friday that its rights offering, which commenced on October 21, will expire at 1700 EST on Tuesday, November 12, 1996.

The trust issued one non-transferable right for each share owned of record on October 18, 1996, the fund said. The rights entitle shareholders to buy one common share for each five rights held, the fund said.
The trust may, at its discretion, issue up to an additional 25 percent of the shares sold in the rights offering pursuant to an over-subscription privilege, Pilgrim America said.

The subscription price will be 97.5 percent of the lower of the trust's November 12, 1996 net asset value or the average closing price of the trust's shares from November 6, 1996 through November 12, 1996.
